title: SAP HCM Consultant
summary: Configures and supports on-premise SAP HCM (or H4S4, HCM running on S/4HANA): employee records called infotypes, organisation structure, time and attendance, and India payroll with PF, ESI, professional tax and income tax. Sits in an SAP project or support team and works closely with HR and payroll teams every month.
dailyDuties: Configure infotypes, personnel actions and organisation structure
Maintain work schedules, absence types and time evaluation
Change payroll schemas, PCRs and wage types for new pay rules
Run and check test payrolls before the monthly cut-off
Update India statutory settings for PF, ESI, PT and income tax
Resolve payroll and time tickets raised by HR users
Write functional specs for custom reports and interfaces

skills.expectation: Configure infotypes, personnel actions, org structure and time management in on-premise SAP HCM or H4S4
Configure and support India payroll: wage types, schemas, PCRs, PF, ESI, PT and income tax
Gather HR and payroll requirements and write functional specifications
Run parallel payroll runs and user acceptance testing before go-live
Resolve payroll and time tickets within service levels during monthly cycles
Explain payroll results and changes clearly to HR and finance users
Work with HR, payroll and finance teams through each payroll cycle and project
Know the PF, ESI, PT and LWF filings the payroll output must support
Understand payroll posting to FI and the GL accounts involved
Debug payroll programs and write specs for custom reports with ABAP developers
Support hybrid setups where Employee Central feeds on-premise payroll
Load employee master and infotype data with LSMW or similar tools

certifications.why: Useful when a client moves core HR to Employee Central and keeps on-premise payroll
